intro: Before anything goes to the AI, student, teacher and school names and contact details are replaced with placeholders. Rules and exceptions saved here apply to the next generation.

status.title: Service status
status.unreachable: Presidio is unreachable; AI generation is paused until it is back
status.not_configured: Presidio is not configured (PRESIDIO_ANALYZER_URL); AI generation is unavailable
status.languages_hint: Pick the languages to analyze; each runs separately and the results are merged. Keep at least one.
status.add_languages_hint: Language models live in the Presidio image. Tick the languages to add, run the command below on the server to rebuild, then enable them here.

rules.title: Custom rules
rules.hint: Words or formats that must always be hidden, such as club names or student numbers. Known students, teachers and schools need no rule.

form.name: Name
form.entries_hint: Only identical text is hidden, in any language.
form.pattern_hint: Runs with Python syntax, case-insensitive. Click an example to use it:
form.languages_hint: Leave all unticked for every enabled language.
form.enabled: Enable as soon as it is saved

allow_list.title: Exceptions
allow_list.hint: Ordinary words that are often hidden by mistake, such as street or course names. Exceptions never override known students, teachers or schools.

test.title: Test bench
test.hint: Paste some text to see what gets hidden. Test text is never logged or sent to an AI.
test.sample: 王小明今天和陳大文在火箭社練習，林老師提醒他們收拾。家長電話 0912-345-678，學號 S123456。Kevin Chen joined from Taipei.
test.use_draft: Use the draft rule being edited
test.ignored: These exceptions contain a known name and were skipped: {words}
test.incomplete: A known name could not be hidden; a real generation would be blocked.
